GOOGL.rationale: Alphabet presents a solid fundamental case with strong and accelerating revenue growth (Q3 2025 revenue $102.35B, QoQ +6.1%), robust margins margins (32.2% net margin, 59.2% gross margin), and a fortress balance sheet ($98.5B cash, $386.9B equity). Google Cloud is growing rapidly (63% YoY per web context) with a massive $462B backlog. The company is deeply embedded in the AI infrastructure buildout with vertical integration across TPUs, Gemini models, and distribution channels. However, valuation has expanded significantly — P/E has risen from ~20x in mid-2025 to ~35x currently, placing it near the top of its 1-year range (19.7-39.5). While not egregiously expensive given growth, the stock is no longer cheap vs its own history. The upcoming Q2 2026 earnings on July 22 (consensus $2.86 EPS, +23.8% YoY) provides a near-term catalyst, with the company having beaten estimates in each of the last four quarters. Berkshire Hathaway's $10B private placement and Alphabet's addition to the Dow are positive institutional signals. Key risks include massive AI capex ($180-190B guided for 2026) compressing free cash flow margins, regulatory headwinds (€4.1B EU fine upheld), and potential dilution from the reported $80B equity raise. The score reflects strong fundamentals and trajectory offset by a valuation that has already re-rated substantially, with a modest positive bump from the imminent earnings catalyst.
